subject: Adds a memory leak check after running a unit test (#1798)
reason: The change only modifies src/unit/test_main.c, the standalone unit-test harness (valkey-unit-tests): after each test suite runs, it checks zmalloc_used_memory() and reports the suite as failed if memory was not freed. This code is compiled only into the unit-test binary and never into valkey-server, valkey-cli, or any other shipped tool, so no server behaviour, reply, replication, persistence, or tool output changes. It is a test/CI infrastructure change with nothing a fuzzer scenario against running servers could reach or break.
